title: Kunga Alafaya (Ashe Ashe)
about: “Kunga alafaya, ashe ashe!” — the Rainbow variant of Funga Alafia, the West-African call-and-response welcome chant (spread from the Nigerian/Liberian greeting song popularised in the U.S. by LaRocque Bey ~1959). Sung with percussion around the fire.
melody_note: Encoded by eye from the free 8notes.com engraving of Funga Alafia (traditional melody, flute-duet edition, lead line, C major) — the route vetted on the melody-routes list; variant identity Kunga Alafaya = Funga Alafia confirmed 2026-09-23. Call bar, response bar (“ashe ashe”), then the repeat closing to the tonic. Draft reading — verify against the 8notes sheet.
verdict: Verdict: pending. The books print words only; melody follows the standard traditional Funga Alafia tune as engraved by 8notes. Confirm the circle sings this shape before promoting.
